fields.body_md:
## About this programme

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) at Coventry University is a one-year, full-time programme. It runs at Coventry University in Coventry. The same course page lists two specialist versions: MBA Global Marketing and MBA AI and Business Analytics. This page covers the MBA.

The MBA has compulsory modules that it shares with the other two versions. One is a 30-credit module on business transformation for sustainable value creation, which is compulsory for the MBA. The course ends with a 50-credit MBA Consultancy Project. You research a real business problem and propose a solution.

The most important thing for an Indian applicant: you need at least three years of relevant work experience after your degree, by the time the course starts.

For the university as a whole, read our [Coventry University page](/study-abroad/universities/coventry-university).

## Can you get in?

To get in, you need an honours degree at 2:2 or above, or an international equivalent, in any discipline. You also need at least three years of relevant work experience after your degree, by the time you start.

If your degree is from India, Coventry's international entry page sets these rules for postgraduate study:

- **60%** in a three-year undergraduate degree
- **55%** in a four-year undergraduate degree

Students from some named Indian universities can be considered with **55%** in a three-year degree. Ask Coventry how your marks are assessed for the MBA before you apply.

You also need an English test score. IELTS (International English Language Testing System) tests your reading, writing, listening and speaking. For the MBA, Coventry asks for an overall IELTS score of **6.5**, with no part lower than **5.5**.

## What it costs

The fees on this page are the 2027-28 figures shown on the MBA course page. Check the fee on the course page before you apply.

**Tuition is £21,825 a year** for international students. The course is one year long, so this is the full tuition.

Before the university releases your CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies), the document you need for your visa, you must pay a tuition deposit. Coventry's apply page says that students from Punjab, Uttarakhand and Haryana in India must pay the full first-year tuition fee as this deposit. Other Indian states are not named in that table, so ask Coventry what deposit applies to you. The due date is in your offer letter.

The UK student visa also asks you to show money for living costs. This is proof of money, not a fee. You keep it in your bank account. If you study outside London, you must show **£1,171 for each month** of your course, for up to **9 months**. You must have had this money for **28 days in a row**. The last day of that 28-day period must be within **31 days** of the day you apply. The UK government sets these amounts, so confirm them on gov.uk before you budget.

Two more visa costs apply. The visa application fee is **£558** when you apply from outside the UK. The Immigration Health Surcharge is a charge that gives you access to the NHS. It is **£776 for each year** of your visa.

Here is a worked example for one year of the MBA:

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027-28 | One year of the course | £21,825 |
| Living money for the visa | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | Fee from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 for 1 year | £776 or more |
| **First-year total** | £21,825 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 | **at least £33,698** |

The £10,539 is money you show, not money you pay. The example does not include flights or spending beyond the visa money.

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs **£1,164**: £776 + £388 = £1,164.

For the visa rules, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs across UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**Coventry University Group Scholarship.** This gives **£2,000 a year** of study off tuition. It is for self-funded international students who pay international fees (EU Bursary holders are excluded), on full-time taught degrees at Coventry's UK Group campuses. You do not need to apply. Your CAS deposit must be cleared by the date in your offer letter, and you must enrol for the 2026/27 or 2027/28 academic year. Online courses are excluded. It cannot be combined with other scholarships, including the Alumni Discount.

For a one-year MBA where you qualify, tuition falls to **£19,825** (£21,825 − £2,000).

**Alumni discount.** Coventry graduates get **25% off** postgraduate courses. This is only for Coventry graduates.

No scholarship is listed for this MBA alone. The full list is on the university's [scholarships page](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/apply-for-a-scholarship/).

## Deadlines and intakes

The MBA starts in September 2027, November 2027, January 2028, March 2028, May 2028 and July 2028. The apply page has its own deadline table. Use it to find the deadline for the start month you want.

Apply early. You can apply for your UK student visa no earlier than **6 months** before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** Confirm your degree and work experience against the rules above. Read the [international entry requirements](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/entry-requirements/).
2. **Get your English test score.** You need IELTS 6.5 overall, with no part below 5.5.
3. **Apply online to Coventry.** Use the university's online application portal. Apply directly to the university. UCAS is for undergraduate courses, so do not use it.
4. **Upload your documents.** You need all academic transcripts, one academic reference, your personal statement, your degree or diploma certificates (or a work reference if you are employed), your English test score and a copy of your passport.
5. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** After you meet the offer conditions and pay the deposit, Coventry issues your CAS.
6. **Apply for your visa.** Use your CAS, your passport and your proof of money. You need a TB test if you are coming to the UK for 6 months or more, you have lived in India for 6 months or more, and you were living there in the last 6 months. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office. See the [TB test guidance](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa).

## After the programme

The university offers one-to-one careers guidance for up to 18 months after the course. Its course page says graduates have worked for companies including TATA, Barclays Bank, Unilever and Shell. No salary figures are given.

**Graduate visa.** This is the post-study work visa. It may let you work in the UK after your course. If you apply on or before 31 December 2026, it lasts **2 years**. If you apply on or after 1 January 2027, it lasts **18 months**. The application fee is **£937**. Read the [Graduate visa guide](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa).

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a 2:2 honours degree or equivalent, and at least three years of relevant work experience.
- You can reach IELTS 6.5, with no part below 5.5.
- You are self-funded and qualify for the £2,000 Group Scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- You will not have three years of relevant work experience by the start date.
- Your Indian marks are close to the 55% or 60% levels. Ask Coventry how they are assessed for the MBA.
- Your savings or family support will not cover the first-year total of at least £33,698.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for the Coventry MBA?
faq_json.a: The MBA course page asks for IELTS 6.5 overall, with no component lower than 5.5. IELTS is an English test.

faq_json.q: How much does the Coventry MBA cost for international students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £21,825 a year for 2027-28 entry. In our worked example, the first year costs at least £33,698 once visa money, the visa fee and the health surcharge are added. The £10,539 is money you show, not a fee.

faq_json.q: Can Indian students get a scholarship for the Coventry MBA?
faq_json.a: The Coventry University Group Scholarship gives £2,000 a year off tuition to self-funded international students who pay international fees. EU Bursary holders are excluded. You do not need to apply. No scholarship is listed for this MBA alone.

faq_json.q: When is the deadline for the January 2027 Coventry MBA intake?
faq_json.a: The final application deadline is 1 December 2026. Offer conditions must be met by 4 December 2026, and enrolment closes on 1 February 2027.

faq_json.q: Can I work in the UK after the Coventry MBA?
faq_json.a: You may be able to work on the Graduate visa. If you apply on or before 31 December 2026, it lasts 2 years. If you apply on or after 1 January 2027, it lasts 18 months. The application fee is £937.
